tools.name: GHL Form Capture
tools.description: Detects and captures lead submissions from GHL-connected web forms and landing pages.

operations.name: detect_submission
operations.description: Listen for new form submissions via GHL webhook (ghl_lead_capture trigger).

operations.name: get_form_fields
operations.description: Retrieve the field mapping for a specific GHL form to normalize incoming data.

tools.name: GHL SMS
tools.description: Send SMS messages via GHL. Used for the critical 60-second auto-response SLA.

operations.name: send_sms
operations.description: Send an SMS to a lead's phone number. Must fire within 60 seconds of lead capture.

tools.name: GHL CRM
tools.description: Create and manage contact records in GoHighLevel CRM.

operations.name: create_contact
operations.description: Create a new CRM contact record with standard and custom fields.

operations.name: update_contact
operations.description: Update an existing contact record with additional data.

operations.name: add_to_pipeline
operations.description: Place a contact into a specific pipeline stage.

tools.name: GHL Auto-Tagging
tools.description: Apply automated tags to GHL contacts based on source, service interest, budget tier, and lead score.

operations.name: apply_tags
operations.description: Apply one or more tags to a GHL contact.

tools.name: GHL Nurture Sequences
tools.description: Trigger GHL nurture/drip sequences based on lead score tier.

operations.name: trigger_sequence
operations.description: Enroll a contact into a specific nurture sequence.

tools.name: Lark Sales Notification
tools.description: Send new lead notifications to the EEVL sales team via Lark channels and direct messages.

operations.name: send_channel_message
operations.description: Post a lead notification to the #sales-leads Lark channel.

operations.name: send_direct_message
operations.description: Send a direct message to a specific sales rep (used for hot lead alerts).

tools.name: Airtable Lead Tracking
tools.description: Track lead capture metrics and SLA compliance in Airtable for reporting and auditing.

operations.name: create_record
operations.description: Create a new lead tracking record in the EEVL Lead Tracker base.
